short_description: Bullous conditions involve fluid-filled blisters forming on the skin. They can result from irritation, burns, infections, or autoimmune diseases.
temporary_advice: Keep the area clean and dry
Cover with sterile dressing if needed
Avoid friction or pressure on the area
avoid: Do not expose to heat or friction
risk_notes: Some blistering conditions can be serious, especially if widespread or linked to infection or immune disease.
when_to_see_doctor: If blisters are large or spreading
If there is pain or fever
If there are signs of infection (pus, redness, swelling)
